tasks.name: Fleet Target Sweep (3 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Three-drone target sweep: Drone 5, Drone 1, and Drone 2 take off together to 17 meters altitude. Drone 5 flies to target Polygon Target 1, Drone 1 flies to target Circle Target 1, and Drone 2 flies to target Polygon Target 2. After reaching the targets, all three drones move west for 73m, then south for 68m, then north for 89m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 73m, south 68m, north 89m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute three-drone sweep mission: Drone 5, Drone 1, Drone 2 take off reaching 17 meters height, fly to targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 1, Polygon Target 2 respectively, then proceed west for 73m, subsequently south for 68m, and finally north for 89m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.
